intent: Show that the monthly price of the insulin Lantus is much higher in the United States than in six other developed countries.

requirements.question: How does the monthly Lantus price in the United States compare with the six other countries?

units.claim: The United States has the highest monthly Lantus price at about $359, compared with about $55 to $74 in the six other countries; even Canada's highest comparison price is under one-fifth of the U.S. price.
accept: the United States has the tallest bar and the highest price
the U.S. price is about $359 while every comparison country is below $75
the U.S. price is nearly five times Canada's price and more than six times Norway's
reject: another country has the highest price
the U.S. price is described as only slightly higher
monthly prices are described as annual prices
the U.S. or a comparison country is omitted
units.evidence: Seven country bars share one monthly-dollar scale; the U.S. bar is substantially taller than all six comparison bars.

optional_valid: Norway is the lowest-priced country at about $55.39 per month.
Canada is the highest-priced comparison country at about $73.97 per month.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all data rows because the table has no role column
